scope.quote: The first objective of this paper is to develop empirical methods to detect real activities manipulation. I examine cash flow from operations (CFO), production costs, and discretionary expenses, variables that should capture the effect of real operations better than accruals. Next, I use these measures to detect real activities manipulation around the zero earnings threshold.
For my primary tests, suspect firm-years are firm-years reporting small annual profits.
H1A. After controlling for sales levels, suspect firm-years exhibit at least one of the following: unusually low cash flow from operations (CFO) OR unusually low discretionary expenses.
